review: Separate AI author investigation and independent AI reproduction; not an independent human review
comparison: Execute the unchanged existing C helper against a complete reference svdpi.h and against the same header with only the shift operator token in SV_GET_SIGNED_BITS split into two less-than tokens. A small native driver calls the helper and prints the existing SV display line.
conclusion: Both compilers accept and execute the existing helper with the incorrect-token header, producing exactly the old expected output. A separate ordinary numerical invocation is syntactically rejected only for that header. Removing spaces merged distinct preprocessing tokens, so the check cannot establish the mapped token identity.
corrective_scope: Withdraw the single check and record a scoped partial-observation hold. Preserve the requirement definition, denominator, existing tests, expectations and old result snapshots. Do not repair the printed bit-N expression.
limits: Native C-helper executions, not fresh simulator runs or simulator oracle grants.
One finite wrong-token counterexample, not an exhaustive tokenizer qualification.
No conclusion about computed sign-extension values or unrelated macros.
The decisive split-token defect does not require interpreting whether equivalent alias definitions are allowed.
